title: AMBER: An LLM-free Multi-dimensional Benchmark for MLLMS Hallucination Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking factual hallucinations in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While model reliability and unfaithfulness can have ethical implications, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary component. The 'Limitations' section discusses technical constraints of the benchmark, not broader ethical considerations.
